info.title: Med-Transcript local export mock API
info.description: Implementation-oriented mock contract for the authenticated local export endpoints. It is not an EHR receiver contract, interoperability certification, or authorization to send patient data.

servers.description: Local development only; use the configured local origin.

post.summary: Create/retrieve an export for an existing clinician-approved version
post.description: Requires authenticated encounter access and an existing current approval. This endpoint creates a local artifact; it does not submit a FHIR transaction or write to an EHR.

409.description: Approval is stale, revoked, or fails current safety/integrity checks

get.summary: Download a previously created local export artifact
get.description: Rechecks encounter access, approval integrity, safety state and artifact digest. FHIR format is returned as JSON containing a DocumentReference resource.

200.description: Verified export bytes; content type depends on export format

409.description: Approval, current safety state, or artifact integrity check failed

x-validation-boundary.fhir_resource_scope: single DocumentReference; not a transaction Bundle
